title: Fire amoeba breaks heat tolerance record for complex life | New Scientist
description: An amoeba living in a Californian hot spring is thriving above 60°C, a threshold previously thought deadly to complex life
author: James Woodford

title: Should we use GLP-1 drugs to treat obesity in children? | New Scientist
description: Children as young as 8 in the US are being prescribed off-label GLP-1 weight-loss drugs, sparking debate about the potential long-term health effects
author: Alice Klein

title: Worried about an AI apocalypse? Here's how to think about the risk of doom | New Scientist
description: Commentators say the probability of machines wiping us out ranges from 0 to over 95 per cent. Columnist Jacob Aron explains why you shouldn't trust any of those numbers
author: Jacob Aron

title: Swimmer made of quantum light breaks Newton's third law | New Scientist
description: According to Newton’s third law, all actions are paired with reciprocal reactions. But breaking this principle allowed an artificial swimmer to move upstream in a quantum stream of light
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan

title: X's Starship will orbit Earth for first time during next flight | New Scientist
description: Starship's next test flight will be its first orbital mission. The craft will also release working Starlink V3 satellites for the first time, making the flight the first commercially useful Starship mission
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: Physicists are scrambling to make sense of possible dark matter signal | New Scientist
description: Following the possible recent detection of a dark matter particle, researchers have already come up with a veritable cornucopia of possible models for what sort of particle it might have been
author: Leah Crane
